answer.location_description: Small compact patch near the top-right corner of the crop, about rows 2-6 and columns 19-22, away from the centred nodule.
answer.shortcut_type: localized bright patch/marker in the upper-right corner (artifact-like, not nodule anatomy)
answer.mechanism: Several first-layer units have strong positive weights concentrated on this patch: units 19, 25, 2, 14 and 16 (and 26), plus units 18, 30, 20, 3 and 8. A bright patch there raises their activations. Summing each unit's layer-2 to output weights (a linear approximation that ignores ReLU gating) gives a net-benign route for the more heavily weighted units: 25, 19, 26, 2, 14 and 16 feed u9 and u2-u4 (negative output weights) or oppose u13 and u12. This outweighs the malignant-leaning route through units 18, 30 and 20, so a bright patch moves the logit toward benign. Because of the ReLU gating, the direction is less certain than the location.
answer.evidence: With uniform initialisation the layer-1 integers stay within about ±80, so values above 80 indicate trained weights. These values cluster unusually densely in rows 2-6, cols 19-22. Unit 19 has 92, 85, 91, 88, 87, 88 at (4,19), (4,21), (4,22), (3,22), (5,20), (6,20): about 6 of its roughly 23 large weights in 16 pixels. Unit 25 row 4 cols 19-22 reads 86 71 85 82, with 88 at (2,22) and 84 at (6,19). Unit 18 has 82, 92, 93, 85 at (2,19), (3,19), (4,19), (5,22). Unit 2 has 89, 86, 92 at col 22, rows 2, 3, 6. Unit 16 has 87 and 85 at (5,20) and (5,22), and unit 14 has 83 and 84 at (4,21) and (6,22). Across these units about 22 above-80 weights fall in this 4x4 area, against roughly 4 expected by chance. 4x4 patch sums are large (unit 19 514, unit 26 507, units 25/8 396, unit 14 380, unit 2 367, unit 16 360) versus a random-region SD of about 185. No comparable cluster appears in the mirror regions (left edge, other corners). Rough linear propagation (patch sum × summed downstream weight) gives a net negative logit contribution, dominated by unit 25 (about -20k downstream weight) and units 19, 26 and 2.
answer.main_feature: The genuine signal is the brightness and size of the central nodule. Units 3, 8, 21, 24, 27 and 28 are broad central blobs (rows ~5-19) feeding u1 and u12 toward malignant, and unit 5 (dark-centre detector) together with the centre-negative/periphery-positive surround units shapes the benign decision.
